caption: The drawing features a central arrangement of agricultural tools and musical instruments, including a sickle, a rake, a sheaf of wheat, a flute, a horn, and a lyre-like instrument. These items are bound together with light blue ribbons and interwoven with clusters of pink roses and green leaves. The background is a neutral, light beige tone. The central composition is framed by two vertical borders, one on each side, decorated with intertwining pink roses, green leaves, and blue ribbons, along with some brown vine-like elements. The overall organization of the objects is symmetrical, with the floral and ribbon motifs adding color and framing the central arrangement. The primary colors in the drawing are pink, green, blue, brown, and beige.
title: Wall Paper
